visualCharacteristics.purpose: links to places on the same page, each with a down arrow
traits: one row of links that wraps, 20px apart
down arrow before every label (lh-arrow-down, navigation link size large)
option columns: one equal column per link (stacked on mobile, two per row from 768px)

contentPattern.structure: One link per row (any rows or cells: every link of the block becomes one item). Link targets are in-page anchors (#heading-id).

usage: Jump links below the intro of hub, info, legal and campaign pages (/de/en/baggage, /de/en/flight-disruptions, /de/en/cookie-policy, /de/en/discover-lufthansa/new-onboard-experience, /de/en/100-years/chronicle).
reuseGuidance: For jump links next to the intro (Lufthansa .airem-sidebar) use columns-media (sidebar) with the links in the second cell.
